STRICT C89 BUILD
================

Core only:

  gcc -std=c89 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic-errors -Iinclude \
    -c src/vp_world.c src/vp_body.c src/vp_contact.c src/vp_joint.c \
       src/vp_solver.c src/vp_ragdoll.c src/vp_debugdraw.c \
       src/vp_state.c src/vp_total_solver.c

Examples:

  make examples

Tests:

  make test

Feature-toggle checks:

  gcc ... -DVP_ENABLE_ISLANDS=0
  gcc ... -DVP_ENABLE_SPLIT_IMPULSE=0
  gcc ... -DVP_ENABLE_ISLANDS=0 -DVP_ENABLE_SPLIT_IMPULSE=0

The strict core and examples use no malloc/realloc/free, no float/double and no
external libraries. Caller-owned static arrays or arenas provide all memory.

MSYS2 / MinGW32
===============

Use the 32-bit shell/toolchain and run:

  mingw32-make CC=gcc strict
  mingw32-make CC=gcc test

If your environment exposes make as `make`, use the normal commands instead.
